cards.title: Lightning arena
cards.text: Burst + Link + Shock + Gunner + Knock. All four modules are in the first set.
cards.why: Your Lightning arena falls out of generic modules, with no special code. That's the test passing.

parts.title: The ring
parts.text: Link on a Burst turns the blast's edge into a ring of linked points. Enemies that touch it join the ring.

parts.title: Sky strikes
parts.text: Gunner on a Burst keeps the area for 2 s and drops strikes inside it.

parts.title: Knockback
parts.text: Knock pushes them back out, the way they came.

parts.title: What's not exact
parts.text: Your version kept 6 even anchors and re-sorted by angle when someone joined. Mine adds them where they touch. Close, not the same.

cards.title: Your three summons
cards.text: Explosive, pet that shoots, swarm. Each is the starting Ball plus modules.
cards.why: These were your examples for why the summon is the base for many things.

parts.title: Explosive
parts.text: Ball + Explode: it blasts when it dies.

parts.title: Pet
parts.text: Ball + Follow + Gunner: Follow makes it find its way to you through the maze; Gunner makes it shoot.

parts.title: Swarm
parts.text: Ball + Swarm: 6 small homing balls that hit by contact.

cards.title: Wings, the big test
cards.text: About 14 modules on one Weapon. The engine can hold it; one run can't.
cards.why: Honest scope. A run's Weapon has 6 slots at most, so the full Wings lives in the practice room, and a run builds a smaller Wings.

parts.title: Fits now
parts.text: Charging orb, side streams, homing bouncing piercing pull orb, hit burst, spirit summon, death blast and aura.

parts.title: Needs later pieces
parts.text: The perpendicular 20-shot wall (a Row pattern), and the laser from the charging orb that forks (an 'On charge level' trigger).

parts.title: Too big for a run
parts.text: About 14 modules. A run tops out at 6 on the Weapon. The practice room has no slot limit.

cards.details:
Weapon = Bolt (big and slow), with:
• Charge — the orb grows while held. ✔
• Gunner — side streams while it flies. ✔
• Home, Bounce ×3, Pierce, Pull — the released orb. ✔
• Rune Every 1 s → Bolt — the trail of small orbs. ✔
• Rune On hit → Bolt + Shrapnel — 12 radial. ✔
• Rune On kill → Ball + Follow + Gunner — the spirit. ✔ except healing allies (no allies yet).
• Rune On end → Burst + Grow + Rune Every 1 s → Burst — death blast and the star-lobbing aura. ✔ at depth 3.
• Rune On wall → Bolt ×20 — the wall of shots. Partly: 'a perpendicular row, each slower than the last' needs a later Row module.
• The laser out of the charging orb that forks at stage 2 — needs a later 'On charge level' trigger.

cards.title: The 21 pressure tests
cards.text: About a third fit fully, a third partly, a third need four later systems.
cards.why: The later systems all fit the same model without changing it. They're listed by how much they add.

parts.title: 1. Capture and throw
parts.text: Grab enemies or shots and launch them. Unlocks the grab ray, the steal ability, smack-to-launch.

parts.title: 2. Origin
parts.text: Fire from the aim point, a mark or a flare instead of from you. Arrow rain, cursor shots, airstrikes.

parts.title: 3. Patterns
parts.text: Rows, helixes, figure eights, formations. Wings' wall, the helix ladder, the water wave.

parts.title: 4. Stage triggers
parts.text: On charge level, on speed below X. Wings' laser, the orb pet that drifts back.

cards.details:
Fit fully: fire tornado that throws fire summons; stomp; rapier lunge; bouncing pet orb; chained homing bomb (minus the tug on you).

Partly: held lightning (no damage scaling down the chain yet); bouncing laser (no head-on split or merge yet); hammer slam (no backflip or spike chains); arrow rain (no flare targeting); rocket boots; spinning black hole; helix ladder (no helix or transform).

Later: steal-and-throw ability, grab ray, curse and bless, smart sticky, water wave, figure-eight boomerang, projectile from the cursor, teleport knife.
